propositions: New hard-fail CI gates and pipeline configuration changes lack a criterion to detect whether branches created before the change would now fail due to missing grandfather guards
Code-review gate dispatch unconditionally activates all project criteria without filtering them against the changed files or their declared applies_to globs

A CI-agnostic advisory criterion is needed that detects hard-fail steps or required gates introduced without if-present or grandfather guards, triggered by changes to pipeline configuration files across multiple CI vendors
The applies_to glob set must be project-overridable via a configuration key to support non-standard CI pipelines without code changes
Criteria routing must support declarative glob-based filtering using the changed-files context already available at the dispatch call site
